purpose: One fixed research-only linear baseline for apparent adult-male appearance from stored exact FFHQ W; no attractiveness prediction
features: float64 copy of saved w[0,0,:], after asserting all18 W rows are identical; 512 dimensions
preprocessing: Per-feature mean/std learned from b2 training records only; std floor1e-8
model: Linear logistic regression with intercept; mean binary log loss +0.5*lambda*sum(weight^2); intercept unpenalized
optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, maxiter300, gtol1e-8, ftol1e-12; deterministic zero weights and training-prior logit intercept
threshold_selection: Both fixed before fitting, report both; do not select a preferred threshold from test results. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.
